# Vendored SAbR

This package is vendored from [delalamo/SAbR](https://github.com/delalamo/SAbR),
upstream revision `0f2549bc98f786e9f84c47ae551a49f19f2f53ed`.

The source repository is retained under `tools-to-implement/SAbR_mimosa`.
Relative imports and package-resource lookups were adjusted so SAbR and its
numbering assets work inside the Studio package without installing a separate
Python distribution. See `LICENSE` and `_anarci/LICENSE` for upstream terms.
